programme.title: The Zodiac
programme.desc: THE ZODIAC takes a different look at the famous Zodiac Killer case from other screen treatments of the murders. More than a simple crime story, the film is an emotional thriller focusing on the murders' impact on victims, their families and the wider community. The film follows a police detective and his son who become obsessed with the murders and endanger their family in the process.

programme.title: The Recall
programme.desc: The great Wesley Snipes (Blade himself!) stars as "The Hunter" in this Mauro Borrelli (The Ghostmaker) directed film. The Recall also stars RJ Mitte (Breaking Bad), Jedidiah Goodacre (Descendants), Niko Pepaj (Awkward), Laura Maria Bilgeri (Toby Goes to Camp) and Hannah Rose May (Ballers). The movie tells the tale of five friends vacationing at a remote lake house, expecting nothing less than a good time. Unbeknownst to them, Earth is under an alien invasion and in the thralls of a mass-abduction. Director Borelli is a former collaborator of director Tim Burton and the film illustrator for blockbuster films such as Pirates of the Caribbean and Captain America. The Recall will also be shot for the new Barco Escape three-screen, panoramic theatrical format, which fully surrounds audiences and offers the ultimate immersive cinema experience. Portions of the films will also be shot in Virtual Reality.

programme.title: The 51st State
programme.desc: In Ronny Yu's fast-moving crime-thriller, Samuel L Jackson plays Elmo McElroy, a pharmaceutical genius who has made a fortune in illegal drugs, particularly with Formula 51, which is more potent than heroin and crack. But instead of selling it to his drug lord employer the Lizard (Meatloaf), he flies to Liverpool where Felix (Robert Carlyle) is acting as broker for gangster Leopold Durant (Ricky Tomlinson). Durant is prepared to offer $20m for the formula; money Elmo would love to spend, if he can stay alive long enough.

programme.title: Operation Chromite
programme.desc: In 1950, just a few months after North Korean forces have overrun most of South Korea, an American-led United Nations Command is deployed to Korea to aid the struggling South Koreans. General Douglas MacArthur devises a secret plan to attack behind enemy lines at the port city of Incheon. The risky strategy is opposed by leaders of the other military branches, forcing MacArthur to devise a clandestine operation to gather essential information from within occupied Incheon by coordinating a weeklong South Korean intelligence operation known as "X-Ray".

programme.title: The Adventure Scouts
programme.desc: A coming of age movie about a group of boys and girls called "adventure scouts" who return from a camping trip to discover their small town is being held captive by a gang of motorcycle-riding knuckleheads. Using only their scouting knowledge and camping equipment, the kids take down the gang members one by one, reunite with family members, and restore the community's sense of pride.

programme.title: Raspberry Magic
programme.desc: "Raspberry Magic" is a coming-of-age story about 11-year-old Monica Shah, who thinks she must win the science fair in order to bring her father back after he runs out on the family. She blames herself for her parents' problems, and takes charge when her mother falls into a deep depression. Set behind the backdrop of a beautiful forest, Monica's experiment uses touch therapy to help raspberries grow faster. She asks, is it nature or nurture that can truly help a being grow? Does it even matter? Through her ups and downs with her family, she learns that it's a complex question, and the answer isn't so simple.

programme.title: No Limit Kids
programme.desc: Ashton, Celeste, and Becca are three unlikely middle school outcasts who form a club in an abandoned theater. There, they meet Charlie (Bill Cobbs, Night at the Museum), a homeless man who shares their passion for musical theater. When the theater is scheduled to be torn down, the teenagers set out to save the landmark with a modern-day performance of Shakespeare's Much Ado About Nothing. Along the way, the group learns to treat others with respect and stand up for their beliefs. This Dove-approved film also features Emmy and Golden Globe nominee Lee Meriwether.

programme.title: Railroad Tigers
programme.desc: In December 1941, Japan expands the occupation of its neighbouring countries to Southeast Asia. The railway from Tianjin to Nanjing in East China became a key military transportation route, heavily guarded by Japanese soldiers. Railroad worker Ma Yuan (Jackie Chan) leads a team of freedom fighters. Using his deep knowledge of the train network, he and his men sabotage it, ambushing Japanese soldiers and stealing supplies to feed the starving Chinese. Although the freedom fighters have no weapons of their own, they employ whatever tools are at hand, including a hammer and shovels, loose railway track planks and diverted trains. The local Chinese call the unlikely heroes the "Railroad Tigers". The freedom fighters find themselves on the wrong side of the tracks when the Japanese send reinforcements to Shandong. In an act of defiance, Ma Yuan launches his most dangerous mission yet, blowing up a heavily guarded railroad bridge. When the Japanese learn of the crippling plan, which will derail the war effort, the stakes are raised even higher. After many missed opportunities and missed shots, the bridge is blown up by the ragtag Chinese railroad tigers.

programme.title: True Smile
programme.desc: Sergio, a 26-year-old autistic male is blind and has never seen a smile. He does, however, give everybody a sincere smile every day. A documentary based on the amazing story encapsulated by Sergio Aznarez Rosado's life.

programme.title: Nico the Unicorn
programme.desc: A 12-year-old disabled boy, whose father recently passed away, has his life changed when the pony he rescues gives birth to a unicorn. Can he save the unicorn from the people who want to exploit it?

programme.title: I Could Never Be Your Woman
programme.desc: Rosie (Michelle Pfeiffer), is a 40-year-old divorced mother who works as a scriptwriter and producer for a TV show ''You Go Girl''. Rosie is insecure about her age, and uses cosmetics to maintain her appearance. She has a very close relationship with her thirteen-year-old daughter, Izzie (Saoirse Ronan), which becomes even closer when she learns that she has fallen for a boy in her class named Dylan (Rory Copus).

programme.title: Almost Friends
programme.desc: Charlie, a culinary genius, has lost the motivation. He doesn't know what to with his life anymore, but he knows one thing - get close to Amber. In comparison to her boyfriend, he seems to be totally unattractive, but Charlie's closest friend convinces him that where there's a will there's a way.

programme.title: Con Man
programme.desc: The story of Barry Minkow, a young charismatic business man who becomes a wealthy CEO by lying, cheating and stealing his way to the top.

programme.title: Looks That Kill
programme.desc: Max Richards, a teenage boy born with a medical condition of being lethally attractive, who is changed forever when he meets Alex, a girl with her own bizarre ailment, who aids him on his quest of self-discovery... without accidentally killing someone.

programme.title: That Trip We Took with Dad
programme.desc: This comedy drama tells the story of a Romanian-German family caught up in the political turmoil of 1968. They start a journey from the city of Arad to the German Democratic Republic, where the older son, Mihai hopes that surgical intervention for his ailing father will restore the family's harmony. Accompanied by Emil, the younger brother, they are caught in the aftermath of the Prague Spring, which alters their plans. Suddenly, they find themselves on the other side of the Iron Curtain in West Germany. In just a few hours, they have to decide: to stay or to go back home?

programme.title: Miss Nobody
programme.desc: Unlucky in love, living at home with her eccentric mom, and stuck in a dead end secretarial job at Judge Pharmaceuticals, Sarah Jane longs for more out of life. Her surprise promotion to junior executive appears to be just the ticket. But with promotion comes a competitive new world of wily, complicated executives, and Sarah Jane begins to eliminate the competition the only way she knows how - murder. During her climb to the top, she unexpectedly falls for the man of her dreams, Detective Bill Malloy - the cop intent on cracking the case of the mysterious deaths at Judge Pharmaceuticals.

programme.title: The Tournament
programme.desc: Every ten years in an unsuspecting town, The Tournament takes place. A battle royale between 40 of the world's deadliest assassins. The last man standing receiving the $10,000,000 cash prize and the title of Worlds No1, which itself carries the legendary million dollar a bullet price tag. All fights are monitored 24hrs a day on redirected CCTV cameras and broadcast secretly to a ring of high stake billionaire gamblers. A gritty, multistranded action-thriller, The Tournament brings together international killers from every imaginable discipline in a blood-bathed contest to the death. We follow the competition favourites through stories of love, betrayal, revenge and redemption as they finally discover the true value of life

programme.title: Extract
programme.desc: Joel Reynolds is the owner and founder of Reynolds Extract, a flavoring-extracts company. Although his business is successful, his marriage lacks passion. He is also often accosted by his annoying neighbor, Nathan. One day, a series of mishaps occur at the extract factory, resulting in an employee, Step, losing a testicle. Cindy, a con artist, reads a news story about the accident. Hatching a get-rich-quick scheme, she gets a temporary job at the factory, manipulating Joel into giving her more information about Step. She also begins a series of petty thefts from her co-workers, who openly accuse each other of the thefts. Although Step initially decides not to sue the company, he changes his mind after a meeting with Cindy, that she sets up in order to meet and flirt with him. Under Cindy's influence, Step hires attorney Joe Adler.

programme.title: Lost in Florence
programme.desc: When Eleroo advises Bumblelion to make a wish when getting the biggest part of the wishbone, it means trouble for poor Rhinokey for losing two bank bags of money. Bumblelion starts spending the money and looses his friends while Rhinokey manages to escape from Officer Eaglebeagle. Rhinokey tries to convince Bumblelion to return the bank bags, but Bumblelion decides to run off thinking that Rhinokey wants to steal his money. Soon after, Bumblelion realizes how Rhinokey lost the bank bags and returns the money to the police.

programme.title: Jungle Boy
programme.desc: In a humble village on the edge of the jungle, a young boy strays from his mother to play with a monkey. Lost in the jungle, he is saved by the great elephant, who will raise him as a member of the great family of animals. When he grows up he helps to protect the jungle from a ruthless poacher.

programme.title: My Dad's Christmas Date
programme.desc: Ever since his wife died, David struggles to get on with his teenage daughter Jules. She feels hemmed in and misunderstood, and he finds himself more and more powerless and lonely. In order to find a new partner for her dad and someone to talk to for herself, Jules creates online profiles on dating sites for David. Things suddenly take a funny turn, because although there is no shortage of candidates, they all fall short of David's ... and Jules's expectations. Will everything take a fresh turn on Christmas? A funny, heartwarming story in a wonderful Xmas mood!

programme.title: Timber the Treasure Dog
programme.desc: A boy rises to the occasion with his best friend (a lovable talking dog) to save his home and family.

programme.title: Score: A Hockey Musical
programme.desc: Seventeen-year-old Farley has led a sheltered life, raised on a diet of home schooling, organic living and trips to the art gallery. To his parents' dismay, Farley loves to play hockey with the local kids. To their even greater dismay, Farley is scouted and signed by the owner of a junior league team, where he becomes an instant star. But Farley discovers that stardom comes with a price - including the expectation to fight on the ice. Throw in a changing relationship with his best friend, and Farley finds himself losing his way.

programme.title: Mayor Cupcake
programme.desc: A hard-working cupcake maker is inadvertently elected mayor of a small town burdened with debt. With no formal experience or education to speak of, she must rely on her street smarts to clean up the town.

programme.title: The Old Man and the Gun
programme.desc: David Lowery's crime biopic stars Robert Redford as Forrest Tucker, a real-life bank robber who found himself wanted by police across the United States for a string of prison escapes and robberies. We first meet Tucker in the early 80s. He's 74 and has been evading police for two years since his last audacious prison break. But he's not taking things easy and laying low. That's not his bag. This suave old geezer has a somehow enamouring way of walking into a bank, charmingly informing the teller that he has a gun that he doesn't want to use, and walking out with a big old sack of cash. In fact, he's just done exactly that when he meets Jewel (Sissy Spacek), an enchanting farmer who he quickly trusts so much that he decides to reveal to her his true identity. Tucker, alongside spending time on Jewel's farm enjoying her more simplistic way of life, embarks on a string of heists. On the case is local detective John Hunt (Casey Affleck), and Tucker soon finds himself torn between the peaceful life he's enjoyed with Jewel and his old criminal ways. Also starring Danny Glover and Tom Waits.

programme.title: 10 Things We Should Do Before We Break Up
programme.desc: Abigail, a self-sufficient single mom meets Ben. They both think every great relationship ends in disaster. On the first date they come up with 10 things to do together before they break up. But the estimated end is not so sure - because fate adds #11 to their list.

programme.title: Corner Office
programme.desc: Orson, a compulsive bureaucrat who discovers a secret room.

programme.title: Foolproof
programme.desc: Kevin, Samantha and Rob live for Foolproof; their own private club where through high-tech, meticulously thought out and executed plans, they pull off the most impossible of heists - all in theory that is. They've never actually done it for real. But all that changes when Leo, a cutthroat British gangster, rips off their foolproof plans for a diamond heist and uses it to successfully execute the robbery. Threatening to implicate them, Leo blackmails them to pull off a robbery worth $20 million in corporate bonds.

programme.title: The Waiting
programme.desc: Jean Barreau leads a spiritual commune on the countryside with the promise of a second life. When their doubles arrive at the house, his followers learn that Jean meant this promise quite literally. However, not everybody is as easily swayed by their capricious leader, who eventually starts to question his own beliefs.

programme.title: The Good Girl
programme.desc: A discount store clerk strikes up an affair with a stock boy who considers himself the incarnation of Holden Caulfield.Justine is a sullen 30-year-old woman stuck in a dead-end job at the Retail Rodeo department store.In addition to her mind-numbing occupation, Justine also has to contend with her dim-witted husband, Phil, and his partner, Bubba, who work as house painters when they aren't smoking pot and staring blankly at the television.Justine sees an opportunity for change, however, when she meets Holden, a fellow Retail Rodeo employee who is even more depressed than herself.The young Holden and Justine soon begin a passionate secret affair, unaware that it may not be so secret after all.

programme.title: Modigliani
programme.desc: American drama, produced in 2004. An American, French, German, Italian, Rumanian, and British co-production. The story of Amedeo Modigliani's bitter rivalry with Pablo Picasso, and his tragic romance with Jeanne Hebuterne.

programme.title: The Flock
programme.desc: This film is about a hyper-vigilant employee of the department of public safety who, while training his young female replacement, has to track down a missing girl who he is convinced is connected to a paroled sex offender he is investigating.

programme.title: Love Is Not Enough
programme.desc: Samir, must face his parent's breakup. While they meet to find the way to tell him, the little Samir surprises them, because he knows perfectly what's happening, putting his own parents into a hard place with his vision of the situation.

programme.title: Trīs musketieri: D'Artanjans
programme.desc: Aleksandra Dimā leģendārā vēsturiskā piedzīvojumu romāna ekranizācijas pirmā daļa stāsta par jauno gaskonieti D'Artanjanu, kurš ierodas Parīzē un nejauši iepazīstas ar trim nešķiramiem draugiem – musketieriem Atosu, Portosu un Aramisu. Drīz vien četrotne tiek iesaistīta galma intrigās un bīstamos piedzīvojumos.

programme.title: 127 Stundas
programme.desc: Filma "127 stundas" balstīta uz patiesiem notikumiem par alpīnistu Āronu Ralstonu, kuru filmā spēlē aktieris Džeimss Franko. Stāsts risinās pēc negadījuma Jūtas štata kanjonos, kad Āronu klinšu aizā iesprosto klintsbluķis, piespiežot viņa roku pret akmens sienu. Turpmākās piecas dienas jeb 127 stundas alpīnists cīnās par dzīvību un ir spiests pieņemt izmisīgu, taču drosmīgu lēmumu, nozāģējot savu roku, kas ir viņa vienīgā iespēja palikt dzīvam.

programme.title: Trīs musketieri: Milēdija
programme.desc: Aleksandra Dimā leģendārā vēsturiskā piedzīvojumu romāna ekranizācijas otrā daļa. D'Artanjana acu priekšā tiek nolaupīta Konstance. Lai glābtu mīļoto, musketieris ir spiests apvienot spēkus ar bezbailīgo un nežēlīgo Milēdiju. Taču karalisti sašķēluši reliģiskie kari un sācies Anglijas iebrukums. Atoss, Portoss un Aramiss jau ir pievienojušies frontei, un kāds sens noslēpums sagrauj vecās alianses.

programme.title: Trīs paziņojumi pie Ebingas Misūri štatā
programme.desc: Mildredas Heizas meita Andžela tika izvarota un noslepkavota pirms vairāk nekā pusgada, taču slepkavības izmeklēšana nevirzās uz priekšu. Mildreda sper izmisīgu un pārdrošu soli - uz ceļa, kura malā Andžela tika atrasta, viņa uz reklāmas stendiem izvieto trīs paziņojumus, kas adresēti Ebingas pilsētiņas šerifam Viljamam Vilobijam. Policija uzskata šo par kara pieteikumu un dara visu, lai paziņojumi tiktu aizvākti. Taču Mildreda nedomā padoties, un spriedze tikai pieaug.

programme.title: Mačete
programme.desc: Bijušo meksikāņu "federale"" ar segvārdu Mačete nodod viņa darba devējs un vēlas viņu nogalināt... Tomēr neticamā veidā Mačete izglābjas. Ar sava drauga, priestera Benito del Toro palīdzību, kurš drauga dēļ ir gatavs atsacīties no nenogalināšanas zvēresta, Mačete dodas asiņainā atriebes ceļojumā. Tajā viņš nežēlo nevienu, kurš stājas viņam pretī. Un, protams, pa ceļam Mačete pagūst apliecināt savu brunču mednieka statusu.

programme.title: Henrija kriminālais gājiens
programme.desc: Henrija dzīve izmainās vienā acumirklī - lai palīdzētu paziņām, viņš dodas uz sporta spēli, taču izrādās, ka viņš nolūkots par šoferi bankas aplaupīšanā. Nonācis cietumā un iepazinies ar asprātīgo Maksu, kurš cietumu uzskata par savām mājām, par labu uzvedību Henrijs drīz tiek brīvībā, lai beidzot izdarītu ko paliekošu. Nu viņš ir nolēmis aplaupīt to pašu banku, par kuras neaplaupīšanu jau sēdēja nebrīvē, un par kompanjonu Henrijs ir nolūkojis Maksu. Taču iejaucas Amors, kurš savu bultu raida untumainās un karstasinīgās Džulas virzienā, un šī sieviete ir aktrise teātrī, kas, kā runā, pa pazemi ar savienots ar Henrija noskatīto banku.

programme.title: Better Man: Robija Viljamsa stāsts
programme.desc: Viņš ir leģenda, viņš ir superzvaigzne, viņš ir hītu autors. Viņa talants, karjera un skandāli vienaldzīgu neatstāj nevienu. Viņš ir Robijs Viljamss un viņa veiksmes talismans ir pērtiķis.

programme.title: Spartaks
programme.desc: Pēc veiksmīgas gladiatoru izbēgšanas Spartaks vada atbrīvoto vergu armiju, vienlaikus izvēloties starp personīgo atriebību pret Romas ģenerāli Glāberu un cīņu par brīvību.

programme.title: 7 dienas Entebē
programme.desc: Uz patiesiem notikumiem balstīta filma par lidmašīnas nolaupīšanu un ķīlnieku krīzi. 1976. gadā tika nolaupīta Air France lidmašīna, kas bija ceļā no Telavivas uz Parīzi caur Atēnām un piespiesta nosēsties Entebē, Ugandā. Pasažieri, kas bija ebreji, tika atdalīti no pārējiem, turēti kā ķīlnieki, un nolaupītāji pieprasīja atbrīvot teroristus, kas ieslodzīti Izraēlas cietumos. Pēc garām debatēm Izraēlas valdība uz Entebi nosūtīja elites vienību, lai atbrīvotu ķīlniekus.

Kad jaunais pāris ierodas Džona vecāku mājās Anglijā, Larita sastopas ar vēsu un aizdomīgu vīramātes attieksmi. Atturīgajiem britiem jaunās sievietes uzvedība šķiet pārāk izaicinoša. Laika gaitā viņu sadarbība pāraugusi romantiskās attiecībās, kas iedvesmo gardus ēdienus, par kuriem sajūsminās pat pasaules izcilākie šefpavāri. programme.title: Labie meli
programme.desc: Pēc tam, kad ienaidnieki iznīcina kādu ciematu Sudānā, bārenis Teo, viņa brāļi, māsas un vietējie ciematiņa iedzīvotāji pārceļas uz bēgļu nometni Kenijā. Pagājuši trīspadsmit gadi kopš šausminošā notikušā, un dzīve viņiem piespēlē nebijušu iespēju - pārcelties uz dzīvi ASV. Kanzasā viņus sagaida nodarbinātības aģentūras darbiniece Kerija Deivisa. Tikšanās ar šo dāmu izmainīs bēgļu dzīves uz visiem laikiem un liks viņu acīs iemirdzēties cerībai par labāku nākotni. Galvenajā lomā Rīza Viterspūna.

programme.title: Ofēlija
programme.desc: Filmā "Ofēlija", kas veidota pēc Lisas Klainas romāna, Ofēlija, slavenā Šekspīra lugas "Hamlets" varone, vēsta savu versiju par to, kā patiesībā risinājās lugā aprakstītie notikumi. Ofēliju, dumpīgo, bez mātes augušo meiteni, pieņem audzināšanā karaliene Ģertrūde. Viņā iemīlas Ģertrūdes dēls princis Hamlets, un viņi slepus apprecas laikā, kad Dānijas karaļvalsti apdraud norvēģu iebrukums un galma iekšienē vērptās intrigas. Ofēlijai un Hamletam ir jāizvēlas starp mīlestību un atriebības alkām.

programme.title: 100 Cooks
programme.desc: It is the biggest home cook competition of all time. Actor, television host and former pro football player Terry Crews hosts as 100 of America's elite home cooks enter the stadium kitchen arena where they will be challenged to the most unpredictable, professional-chef level cooking competition ever. As the competition begins, chefs are selected at random to come to the floor to compete while the "Challenge Mixer" dictates the challenges they will face ranging from fast-paced trivia contests to 30-minute do-or-die cooking battles. Top culinary content creator Nick DiGiovanni and chef and NYT best-selling cookbook author Alex Guarnaschelli are the judges that determine who stays and who goes. Each round's winner will be given a chance to take the cash or add it to the ever-growing grand prize pot, which starts at $100,000...so as the number of cooks goes down, the grand prize goes up.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: BBQ Brawl: Flay V. Symon
programme.desc: Join our hosts, renowned celebrity chefs and restaurateurs Bobby Flay and Michael Symon, as they test the skills of eight expert barbecue connoisseurs. Filmed at the Star Hill Ranch in Austin, Texas, the eight chefs are divided into two teams but, in order to claim first pick for their team, Bobby and Michael go head-to-head in a backyard BBQ challenge. Each episode sees one of the chefs being eliminated from the show until there is only one left, the winner who is awarded the title of 'Master of Cue'. The weekly contests aim to reveal the chefs' talents and expose their weaknesses and include tasks such as cooking up a tomahawk rib-eye and taking on a Texas beef challenge.

programme.title: Man v. Food
programme.desc: Join our host, and one-man eating machine, Adam Richman as he travels across his native US to indulge his appetite for the meatiest and mightiest portions of America's favourite dishes. Adam visits many iconic towns and cities to investigate the local specialities before challenging himself to eat the biggest portions that a particular restaurant can throw at him. Beginning in Columbus, Ohio, Adam faces down a smorgasbord of sausage varieites before heading off to Indianapolis to take a chunk out of a massive pork tenderloin sandwich. Further episodes see Adam go head-to-head with a whole hog in Raleigh and tackle the biggest burger in Boise.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: It's Ree Drummond's birthday, and she's celebrating by making over some of her all-time favorite recipes and road-testing them for social media. She starts with Mini Turkey Meatloaves, a thoroughly modern take on a comfort food classic. Her Cauliflower "Mac" and Cheese is a tasty remix with less of the mac and all of the cheesy goodness, and her Baked Chili-Garlic Fries with Light Fry Sauce are another light variation. Every birthday deserves a cake, so Ree revamps her go-to recipe and makes a Flourless Chocolate Cake that's worth celebrating.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: It's cookie day, and Ree Drummond's baking a fantastic foursome to share with friends and family. There are awesome Chocolate Mint Iced Cookies decorated with swirls of snow white royal icing, Browned Butter Sugar Cookies that become the base for Cookie Jam Pies, next-level Chocolate Chip Cookies with Bacon and Caramel Corn, and No Bake Cookies made with grains, seeds, fruits and nuts. Ree packs them all into cute cookie collections for the kids to hand deliver to friends and family.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Ree Drummond is reclaiming kitchen scraps and transforming them into star dishes. Peels, stems and bones destined for the trash are instead turned into crispy Roasted Potato Peels, Stir Fried Broccoli Stems and an awesome all-purpose Overnight Chicken Broth. Then she raids the fridge for leftovers to use in a frugal Crisper Crash Frittata and gives past-its-prime fruit a second chance with Leftover Fruit Bread. Ree turns pie crust scraps into four stunning treats and finally upcycles cheese scraps into the ultimate Leftover Cheese Dip.

programme.title: Ranch To Table
programme.desc: Elizabeth celebrates springtime on the ranch by harvesting fresh honey to use in a honey lemon cake. She also puts the honey to use preparing lemon buttermilk fried chicken as a thank you gift for her neighbors.

programme.title: Ranch To Table
programme.desc: Elizabeth bakes a hummingbird breakfast cake to help fuel the cowboy crew. Later, she serves brisket sandwiches out of the tailgate of her pickup truck.

programme.title: Cooking With Choi
programme.desc: Esther Choi teaches how to make two types of kimchi and shares kimchi recipes, including kimchi fried rice and Korean pork belly wraps.

programme.title: Street Food In Africa
programme.desc: Join famous Chef Nti on her journey through Africa, bound to tantalize your taste buds, as she introduces the variety of African cuisine and showcases a number of popular street food in Africa. The first show to represent and promote globally rich culinary heritage of Chef Nti's country, South Africa, hoping to expand to other parts of Africa and share more delicious stories with the viewers. The chef will also recreate famous dishes in her own kitchen and share her tips and trick in preparing them.

programme.title: Kids Baking Championship
programme.desc: In Food Network's series Kids Baking Championship, hosts and judges Duff Goldman and Valerie Bertinelli will lead eight talented kid bakers through challenges designed to find the most-impressive and creative young baker. In each challenge the contestants, ranging in age from 10 to 13, will be tested on their baking skills and originality as they whip up delectable desserts, including creative cakes, mouthwatering cookies and pastries.

programme.title: Girl Meets Farm
programme.desc: Molly Yeh is a cookbook author who combines her country lifestyle with her Jewish and Chinese heritage to create the most delicious new dishes. A former big city girl, Yeh is multi talented, a successful blogger and classically trained musician, its food that ultimately stole her heart. Learn lots of tricks and tips with Yeh as she cooks up her personal favourite recipes for every occasion, from family visits to brunch with the girls to a classic farm supper! This show is an absolute treat.

programme.title: The Pioneer Woman
programme.desc: Take one sassy former city girl, her hunky rancher husband and a band of adorable kids, an extended family, cowboys, 3000 wild mustangs, a herd of cattle and one placid basset hound and you have The Pioneer Woman. The Pioneer Woman is an open invitation into Ree Drummond's life: The award-winning blogger and best-selling cookbook author comes to Food Network and shares her special brand of home cooking, from throw-together suppers to elegant celebrations. The series, set against the incredible story of life at home on the range, is the next best thing to actually sitting on a stool in Ree's kitchen.

programme.title: Chopped
programme.desc: Chopped is an American reality cooking TV game show hosted by Ted Allen. Four chefs compete against each other. At the beginning of each round they receive a basket containing four mystery ingredients and are expected to create the best three-course meal using every single one of them. Each round has a time limit. The dishes are judged based on their presentation, taste and creativity. At the end of every round one chef is "chopped" from the competition with no prize. The winner can get up to $50.000.

programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Bizarre Foods
programme.desc: Travel and cuisine documentary series, hosted by famous Andrew Zimmern, American culinary expert, chef, restaurateur and television personality and spin-off series of ''Bizarre Foods'', focuses on classic, iconic foods (not bizarre like in the original series) from some well-known destinations- moussaka and real Greek yogurt from Athens, sweet macarons and crepes from Paris, Italian gelato, gooey fondue to Swiss chocolate from Zurich, mile-high pastrami sandwiches and bagels from NYC, and many other legendary foods. The show will explore where these dishes came from, how they're prepared, and the best way to enjoy them. Andrew will also discover some secrets and interesting stories behind these epic meals.

programme.title: When the Water Screams
programme.desc: Water is both the essence of life and one of nature's most powerful voices. This compelling documentary explores how water reflects the growing imbalance between humanity and the natural world. From devastating floods to severe droughts and polluted rivers, it uncovers the consequences of environmental neglect. Featuring expert insights, personal testimonies, and striking visuals, the film presents a vivid portrait of a planet under pressure, urging viewers to recognize the warning signs and reconsider their relationship with nature.

programme.title: Return. Heroes on Shield
programme.desc: This moving documentary examines the challenging work of locating, identifying, and returning fallen soldiers to their homeland. By focusing on the people who carry out these missions and the families awaiting answers, the film offers a poignant look at duty, dignity, and the lasting consequences of conflict.

programme.title: Kherson: A People Safari
programme.desc: This is a 72-minute documentary about one of the most invincible cities in Ukraine during the Great War. This is the story of Kherson, from the first days of the full-scale Russian invasion, through the difficult years of occupation, to the long-awaited liberation and constant Russian shelling. But it is not only about the war - it is also about how life goes on, even when everything around it seems to be crumbling.

programme.title: Armagedons
programme.desc: NASA uzzina, ka Zemei tuvojas milzīgs asteroīds. Sadursme ar to nozīmē tikai vienu - pastarā diena vairs nav aiz kalniem... Cilvēci no iznīcības var glābt tikai brīnums. Par brīnumdariem varētu kļūt daži drosmīgi vīri, kuri kosmosā dodas ar īpašu misiju - iznīcināt asteroīdu, vēl pirms tas sasniedzis zemi. Cik daudz drosmes un sprāgstvielu nepieciešams, lai iznīcinātu šo 'briesmoni', kas izmēru ziņā sasniedz vesela štata apmērus? 1999. gadā filma izpelnījusies četras "Oskara" nominācijas, tajā skaitā nominācijā Gada labākā dziesma - "I Don't Want To Miss A Thing" leģendārās rokgrupas "Aerosmith" izpildījumā.

programme.title: Cits cilvēks
programme.desc: Kritiķu cildināta tumšā komēdija par topošu aktieri, kurš, lai pārveidotu savu izskatu, veic radikālu medicīnisku procedūru, bet jaunā seja ātri pārvērš viņa dzīvi murgā.

programme.title: Nabaga radības
programme.desc: Sava nežēlīgā vīra ietekmē Bella (Emma Stouna) ir izdarījusi pašnāvību, taču ekscentrisks zinātnieks (Vilems Defo) nolemj izglābt sievieti un pārstāda viņai pašas vēl nedzimušā bērna smadzenes. Viņa aizbildniecībā Bella alkst mācīties un iepazīt dzīvi, kas Viktorijas laikmeta stingrajā sabiedrībā viņai līdz šim bijusi liegta. Kopā ar viltīgo un valdzinoši cinisko juristu Dankanu Vederbērnu viņa dodas ceļojumā pāri kontinentiem. Ceļojuma laikā Bella arvien vairāk atbrīvojas no sava laikmeta aizspriedumiem un sabiedrības ierobežojumiem.

programme.title: Dziedi!
programme.desc: Kad viņa teātrim draud slēgšana, uzņēmējdarbībā pieredzējušais koala Basters Mūns (Metjū Makkonahijs) sarīko dziesmu konkursu. Daudziem vietējiem zvēriem tas rada iespēju izpausties. Cūka Rosita (Rīza Viterspūna) ir māte un mājsaimniece, kura atteicās no pusaudža sapņa kļūt par dziedātāju. Pusaudze dzeloņcūka Eša (Skārleta Johansone) ir pancīga roķere alternatīvās mūzikas grupā. Gorillu Džoniju (Tārons Edžertons) viņa tēvs (Pīters Serafinovičs) grib pārliecināt pievērsties savam banku aplaupītāja arodam. Ikkatrs no šiem radījumiem vēlas piepildīt savu sapni un dziedāt no visas sirds!

programme.title: Rūfuss: jūras briesmonis, kas nemācēja peldēt
programme.desc: Rufuss īsti neiederas – savā jūras čūsku kopienā viņš ir vienīgais, kurš neprot peldēt. Kad notiek nelaime un viņu slepenā sala ir jāaizsargā, Rufusam jāsastopas ar savām lielākajām bailēm un jāizglābj ģimene.

programme.title: Mazais Stjuarts
programme.desc: Pēc tam, kad futbola spēlē mazais Stjuarts par mata tiesu izvairās no nopietnas traumas, viņa audžumāmiņa sāk pārmērīgi uztraukties par pelēna drošību. Lielais brālis Džordžs savukārt ir atradis sev jaunu draugu un atstājis Stjuartu novārtā. Kad drosmīgais pelēns izglābj no vanaga nagiem kanārijputniņu Margalo, viņa sāk dzīvot kopā ar Litlu ģimeni. Taču kādu dienu Stjuarta jaunā draudzene vairs nekur nav atrodama. Stjuarts un viņa kādreizējais ļaunākais ienaidnieks kaķis Sniegapika apvienojas, lai atrastu Margolo. Savukārt Džordžs pirmo reizi mūžā ir spiests piesegt mazā brālīša prombūtni un melot māmiņai.

programme.title: Viesnīca Transilvānija
programme.desc: Laipni lūgti viesnīcā "Transilvānija", Drakulas krāšņajā pieczobu kūrortā, kurā monstri var izbaudīt nesteidzīgu atpūtu. Ir pienākusi īpaša nedēļas nogale, kuras laikā Drakula ir ielūdzis ciemos dažus no saviem labākajiem draugiem. Ir plānots svinēt Drakulas meitas Meivisas pilngadību – 118. dzimšanas dienu. Uzņemt tik kuplu viesu pulku Drakulas ģimenei nav problēma. Tomēr jukas izceļas, kad viesnīcā ieklīst parasts puisis un ieskatās viņa meitā.

programme.title: Haralds un burvju krītiņš
programme.desc: Savā grāmatā piedzīvojumu kārais Haralds var atdzīvināt jebko, to vienkārši uzzīmējot. Pieaugot un attālinoties no grāmatas lappusēm un nonākot reālajā pasaulē, Haralds saprot, ka viņam ir daudz jāmācās par īsto dzīvi.

programme.title: Džumandži: Laipni lūgti džungļos
programme.desc: Četri vidusskolēni atrod vecu spēļu konsoli ar līdz šim neredzētu videospēli džumandži. Viņi iesaistās šajā spēlē, kas norisinās džungļos, un iemiesojas pašu izraudzītajos avataros. Jaunieši apjauš, ka džumandži ir kas vairāk par spēli, tā ir cīņa par izdzīvošanu. Lai uzvarētu spēlē, viņiem jādodas bīstamākajā piedzīvojumā mūžā, jāatklāj Alana Periša pirms 20 gadiem atstātās pēdas un jāmaina priekšstats pašiem par sevi, pretējā gadījumā viņi paliks ieslēgti spēlē uz visiem laikiem...

programme.title: Spoku mednieki: Sasaluma impērija
programme.desc: Spengleru ģimene atgriežas vietā, kur viss sākās – ikoniskajā Ņujorkas ugunsdzēsēju depo –, lai apvienotos ar sākotnējiem Spoku medniekiem, kuri izveidojuši īpaši slepenu izpētes laboratoriju, paceļot spoku medīšanu nākamajā līmenī. Bet, kad sena artefakta atklāšana atbrīvo ļaunu spēku, jaunajiem un vecajiem Spoku medniekiem jākļūst par vienu komandu, lai aizstāvētu savu pilsētu un glābtu pasauli no jauna ledus laikmeta.

programme.title: Čārlija eņģeļi
programme.desc: Noslēpumainā Čārlza Taunsenda detektīvaģentūra atvērusi birojus visā pasaulē. Tās paspārnē vairāku Bosliju vadībā izveidotas Eņģeļu komandas, kurās darbojas visgudrākās, visdrosmīgākās un visaugstāk kvalificētās sievietes, kam jātiek galā ar vissarežģītākajiem uzdevumiem jebkur uz zemeslodes.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Reiz uz kādas paradīzes salas dzīvoja putni, kas nemācēja lidot. Tāpēc viņi visi bija labi, miermīlīgi un laimīgi... Precīzāk, gandrīz visi. Uz pārējo salas iemītnieku fona depresīvais Reds, trauksmainais Čaks un neveiklais Bumba izcēlās ar savu neparedzamo uzvedību un skaitījās izstumtie. Taču, kad salā pēkšņi parādījās noslēpumainās zaļās cūkas, kam noteikti aiz ādas bija kāda cūcība, tieši Reds, Čaks un Bumba stājās viņiem pretī!

programme.title: Sapņi
programme.desc: Ietekmīga sabiedrības dāma un daudzsološs baleta dejotājs uzsāk bīstamu romānu. Kad viņš slepeni šķērso ASV un Meksikas robežu, viņa sper izmisīgus soļus, lai pasargātu viņu kopīgo nākotni.

programme.title: Slēpnis
programme.desc: Kāds vientuļnieks uz attālas Skotijas salas izglābj meiteni no jūras, izraisot bīstamu notikumu virkni, kas kulminējas ar uzbrukumu viņa mājām, liekot viņam saskarties ar savu nemierīgo pagātni.

programme.title: Greja piecdesmit nokrāsas
programme.desc: Koledžas studente Anastasija Stīla savas saslimušās istabas biedrenes vietā dodas intervēt slaveno uzņēmēju Kristianu Greju universitātes avīzei, taču meitene nenojauš, kā mainīsies viņas dzīve. Noslēpumainajam, bagātajam un ietekmīgajam Kristianam iepatīkas Ana. Lai gan meitenes seksuālā pieredze ir visai niecīga, viņa ļaujas šai dēkai un uzzina, ka Kristiana seksuālās tieksmes pārkāpj sāpju un baudas robežas.

programme.title: Sliktie kaimiņi
programme.desc: Kellijai un Mekam šķiet, ka viņi kopā ar jaundzimušo bērnu ir pārcēlušies uz klusu rajonu, taču tad kaimiņos ievācas studentu korporācijas puiši. Tedijs ir korporācijas prezidents, un Pīts ir viņa vietnieks. Puiši naski pieņem draudzības piedāvājumu, kad Kellija un Meks ierodas iepazīties. Tomēr drīz vien laulātajam pārim ir jāsauc talkā policija jauno kaimiņu savaldīšanai. Šī rīcība izraisa šausminošas sekas.

programme.title: Zirnekļcilvēks: Pāri Zirnekļpasaulei
programme.desc: Mailss Moraless atgriežas uz ekrāniem nākamajā ar Oskaru apbalvotās Zirnekļpasaules sāgas nodaļā. Varenais piedzīvojums nogādās Zirnekļcilvēku no Bruklinas draudzīgās apkaimes pāri Zirnekļpasaulei, lai viņš apvienotu spēkus ar Gvenu Steisiju un jauno zirnekļļaužu komandu un stātos pretī ļaundarim, par kuru spēcīgāku viņi vēl nav satikuši.

programme.title: Smurfi
programme.desc: Laipni lūdzam smurfu pasaulē! Burvis Gargamels ir piespiedis smurfus bēgt no dzimtā ciema. Ģimenes komēdija, kurā animācijas filmas varoņi parādās spēlfilmā.

programme.title: Debesis patiešām ir īstas
programme.desc: Kādam mazpilsētas tēvam jāatrod drosme un pārliecība pastāstīt pasaulei par sava mazā dēla īpašo, dzīvi mainošo pieredzējumu.

programme.title: Gārfīlds
programme.desc: Pasaulslaveno pirmdienu nīdēju un lazanjas mīlētāju mājas kaķi Garfīldu gaida vājprātīgi jautrs piedzīvojums brīvā dabā! Negaidīti saticis savu sen zudušo tēvu, noplukušo ielas kaķi Viku, Gārfīlds kopā ar savu draugu, suni Odiju, ir spiests pamest ideālo lutekļa dzīvi un piebiedroties Vikam pārgalvīgā laupīšanā.

programme.title: Viss ir patiess
programme.desc: Ir 1613. gads, un Šekspīrs jau novērtēts kā šī laikmeta lieliskākais rakstnieks. Tomēr notiek traģēdija, un viņa slavenais Globe teātris Londonā nodeg līdz pašiem pamatiem. Saguris Šekspīrs atgriežas Stretfordā, kur viņam jāsaskaras ar savu smago pagātni un nolaidīgo ģimeni. Sava vienīgā dēla Hamneta nāves vajāts, viņam ir grūtības salabot attiecības ar ģimeni. Tomēr, to cenšoties, viņš ir spiests atkal un atkal izvērtēt savas neveiksmes.

programme.title: Apbrīnojamais Zirnekļcilvēks
programme.desc: Stāsts par Pīteru Pārkeru, vienaudžu izstumtu vidusskolnieku, ko pametuši vecāki un uzaudzinājuši tēvocis Bens un tante Meja. Pīters cenšas atrast savu vietu dzīvē un rast iespēju būt kopā ar savu pirmo skolas mīlestību Gvenu. Kad Pīters atrod noslēpumainu koferi, kas piederējis viņa tēvam, viņš sāk saprast savu vecāku pazušanas iemeslus un nonāk uz pēdām doktoram Kurtam Konorsam, kas ir viņa tēva bijušais biznesa partneris. Drīz vien Pīteram nākas pieņemt izšķirošus lēmumus un likt lietā savu spēku un spējas, lai kļūtu par to, ko viņam lēmis liktenis, - par varoni.

programme.title: Apbrīnojamais Zirnekļcilvēks
programme.desc: Visnozīmīgākā cīņa Zirnekļcilvēkam notiek viņā pašā – bezgalīga sacensība starp Pītera Parkera ikdienišķiem pienākumiem un Zirnekļcilvēka milzīgo atbildību. Taču kulta blokbastera turpinājumā mēs noskaidrosim, ka nākotnē Pīteru gaida daudz nopietnāka kauja un būt Zirnekļcilvēkam joprojām ir tikpat forši.

programme.title: Dusmīgie putni. Filma
programme.desc: Nelidojošie dusmīgie putni joprojām karo ar viltīgajām zaļajām cūkām. Viņi ir ļaunākie ienaidnieki, un, šķiet, nekas nespēs to mainīt. Taču, kad pie apvāršņa parādās jaunas briesmas, kas apdraud viņus visus, putniem un cūkām nāksies apvienoties, lai glābtu savas mājas.

programme.title: Grenlande. Migrācija
programme.desc: Izdzīvojusi Grenlandes bunkurā, Garitiju ģimene dodas pāri sagrautai Eiropai, lai atrastu jaunas mājas.

programme.title: Sliktie kaimiņi
programme.desc: Maks (Sets Rogens) un Kellija (Roza Bairna) gaida otru bērnu un nolemj pārvākties uz citurieni. Viņu plānam traucē Šelbija (Hloja Greisa Moreca), kura mēģina nodibināt studenšu klubu, lai viņa ar draugiem varētu rīkot savas ballītes. Abas grupas drīzumā kļūst par zvērinātiem ienaidniekiem, jo atšķiras to uzskati par skaļu mūziku un nepārtrauktu dzerstiņu. Maks un Kellija drīz sauc palīgā bijušo ienaidnieku Tediju (Zaks Efrons), lai neļautu kubam "Kappa Nu" turpināt traucēt dzīvi apkārtnē.

programme.title: Lemāna-'66: Lielais izaicinājums
programme.desc: Filmas sižets balstīts patiesos notikumus un atgādina par autosporta vēstures spriedzes pilnām lapaspusēm. Notikumi risinās 60. gados, kad konstruktoru grupa, kuru vadīja Kerols Šelbijs, kopā ar britu sacīkšu braucēju Kenu Mailsu uzbūvēja vēl nebijušu "Ford" sporta automašīnu un meta izaicinājumu Lemānas 24 stundu sacīkšu favorītam "Ferrari".

programme.title: Venoms: Pēdējā Deja

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Pawn Stars
programme.desc: Long before banks, ATMs and check-cashing services, there were pawn shops. Pawning was the leading form of consumer credit in the United States until the 1950s, and pawn shops are still helping everyday people make ends meet. "Pawn Stars" takes you inside the colorful world of the pawn business. At the Gold & Silver Pawn Shop on the outskirts of Las Vegas, three generations of the Harrison family — grandfather Richard, son Rick and grandson Corey — jointly run the family business, and there's clashing and camaraderie every step of the way. The three men use their sharp eyes and skills to assess the value of items from the commonplace to the truly historic, including a 16th-century samurai sword, a Super Bowl ring, a Picasso painting and a 17th-century stay of execution. It's up to them to determine what's real and what's fake, as they reveal the often surprising answer to the questions on everyone's mind, "What's the story behind it?" and "What's it worth?"

programme.title: The Curse of Oak Island
programme.desc: For over two centuries, teams of searchers, including Franklin D. Roosevelt, have attempted to crack the code that will unearth the treasure believed to be buried on the small island off the coast of Nova Scotia. Armed with the knowledge of those that came before them, the muscle of heavy machinery and decades of engineering know-how, brothers Rick and Marty Lagina and their partners may be closer than anyone in history to finding the treasure that has so far claimed the lives of six men.

programme.desc: One of the most infamous pirates to prowl America's Gulf Coast--Jean Lafitte--led what may have been the largest pirate fleet in the world. programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner

programme.title: Pawn Stars

programme.title: Greatest Mysteries with Laurence Fishburne
programme.desc: Investigate a wide range of historically compelling topics and the mysteries surrounding each including the Titanic, D.B. Cooper, Roswell, John Wilkes Booth, and more. Each program within the franchise will showcase fresh, new evidence and perspectives including never-before-released documents to the general public, personal diaries and DNA evidence to unearth brand-new information about these infamous and enigmatic chapters in history.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: A&E presents the new original real-life series "Storage Wars," which follows professional buyers and their teams as they scour repossessed storage units in search of hidden treasure. Part gamblers, part detectives, these auction pros have found everything from coffins to the world's most valuable comic book collection, paying as little as ten dollars for items valued in the millions. Each episode of "Storage Wars" follows a group of bidders as they get a quick peek inside the units, aided only by the beam of a flashlight. They then must assess on the spot if the unit is worth a bid and how high they will actually go to grasp the gold. The high-stakes fun begins as we see if the resulting buy is full of mostly trash... or true treasure. Driven by Dan Dotson, one of the most successful and outrageous auctioneers in the country, the cast of buyers is as colorful and varied as the treasures they uncover.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Following declassified FBI files that link Hitler's U-boat unloading site to a massive German owned estate in the Southern Andes, the team uncovers the town of Bariloche and the Inalco House, where Hitler could have stayed. After trying to gain access to the property with aerial drones and a secret swim through the water, the team is able to take photos of the mysterious interior as well as finds a vent that could lead to a bunker.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Wondrous wizards... Mysterious sorcerers... And heavenly beings... possessed of unimaginable power. Throughout the ancient world, magic was used for everything from healing to communicating with the gods. But did magic really exist in the ancient times? Not as a form of theater - but as a means of replicating the power of the gods? Do ancient accounts of magic suggest evidence of advanced, otherworldly knowledge? A knowledge given to early humans as a means of helping them unlock their own - some might say "divine" - potential?

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

Spanning each river's layered past, the new series will offer a fresh perspective and even redefine our history as we know it. Using state-of-the-art technology, archive maps and contemporaneous accounts from the period, Beau and Rick perform the first underwater archeological digs in some of the most exciting and iconic historical sites in Britain, often in dangerous and fast-flowing water.

programme.title: Gold Hunters: Legend of the Superstition Mountains
programme.desc: Legend tells of the Lost Dutchman's gold mine hidden somewhere within the 160,000 acres of brutal Arizona desert known as the "Superstition Mountains." The promise of a $200 million mother lode has lured thousands of treasure hunters and continues to claim the lives of those eager to decipher the legend's clues and riddles. Hunting for the Lost Dutchman is typically a one-man journey, but lifelong Dutch Hunter Wayne Tuttle is breaking with tradition and partnering with a team of experts to follow a newly revealed clue that could finally solve the 500-year-old mystery of America's most famous and deadliest buried treasure. With cursed mountains said to drive men mad and a hidden fortune of gold worth killing for, the treasure hunter's greatest danger may be the man at his side. Trust at your own peril if you dare to tread into HISTORY's Legend of the Superstition Mountains.

programme.title: The UnXplained with William Shatner
programme.desc: From the producers of Ancient Aliens® and The Curse of Oak Island® From alleged UFO encounters to sudden disappearances to evil possessions, series host William Shatner attempts to get to the truth behind the most bizarre and mysterious events ever reported. With the help of the world's top scientists, first-hand "experiencer" accounts, and dramatic reenactments, viewers gain shocking insight into what's really happening--and why.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: Following declassified FBI files that link Hitler's U-boat unloading site to a massive German owned estate in the Southern Andes, the team uncovers the town of Bariloche and the Inalco House, where Hitler could have stayed. After trying to gain access to the property with aerial drones and a secret swim through the water, the team is able to take photos of the mysterious interior as well as finds a vent that could lead to a bunker.

programme.title: The Universe
programme.desc: Every day, new information is discovered that helps us better understand how our Universe works. Some of this evidence solves mysteries dating back thousands of years. Some evidence offers new theories on how human civilization came into existence. In this season of The Universe: Ancient Mysteries Solved, we'll tackle mysteries such as an American Stonehenge built 500 years before Columbus, and how the Aztec Pyramids helped seal the downfall of the Mayan and Aztec empires. We'll also look at some of the Roman Empires' most iconic structures, and their connection to archeo-astronomy.

programme.title: The Hunt for Baltic Gold
programme.desc: Amber has been coveted in Poland since the 15th century, when handmade jewellery incorporating this semi-precious stone (even though it is not a 'stone') was sought after by members of the Royal, Imperial, Papal and Ottoman Courts. With 70% of the world's amber being produced in Poland, the industry is still thriving, especially in the coastal areas around the port city of Gdansk. The viewer will learn about the journey of amber, from its origins as fossilized tree resin to its extraction from the ground and its transfromation into creative and beautiful decorations. The show also tells the story of the people who work in the industry and the difficulties they face in harvesting the amber, getting it to market and selling it.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Wondrous wizards... Mysterious sorcerers... And heavenly beings... possessed of unimaginable power. Throughout the ancient world, magic was used for everything from healing to communicating with the gods. But did magic really exist in the ancient times? Not as a form of theater - but as a means of replicating the power of the gods? Do ancient accounts of magic suggest evidence of advanced, otherworldly knowledge? A knowledge given to early humans as a means of helping them unlock their own - some might say "divine" - potential?

programme.title: MonsterQuest
programme.desc: From Bigfoot to Swamp Beast, Monster Quest reveals the truth of legendary monster sightings around the world. Deploying the latest in hi-tech equipment, each episode scientifically examines the best evidence available, from pictures and video, to hair and bones, as well as the eyewitness accounts themselves. From pilots to policemen to ship captains, a number of seemingly credible people have seen things they can't explain. One part history, one part science and one part monsters, Monster Quest discovers the truth behind these legendary monsters.

programme.title: River Hunters
programme.desc: In River Hunters, Rick Edwards and river-searching expert Beau Ouimette visit some of the most historically significant sites across Britain: covering iconic events and battles including Roman Briton, the Wars of the Roses, the Reformation and the English Civil War. Their searches of these unexplored rivers and waterways unearth treasures from the past which reveal how our various ancestors used to live. As the artefacts surface from under layers of silt and rocks, the duo will meet with local archaeologists and historians to unearth the stories and people behind the finds. programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: In the climax of the investigation, the head of the team leads a search of two marshes in the heart of Bogota that are listed in the declassified FBI files as being the location of a submerged plane that transported Hitler to the area. Using historical maps and cutting edge technology the team corroborates information from the FBI file and finds evidence of a suspicious object buried deep in the mud of a marsh matching the description within the files, which could be a plane!

programme.title: The Universe

programme.title: Lost Relics of the Knights Templar
programme.desc: Lost Relic Hunters follows the work of one of the world's most prolific collectors of antiquities, Hamilton White, and his long-time friend and business partner, Carl Cookson. The intrepid duo are back on the trail of some truly astonishing relics and historical pieces, which, if authenticated, will potentially change our understanding of some of the most iconic periods of British and European history. Aided in their adventures by cultural and art historian Dr Janina Ramirez, Lost Relic Hunters sees Carl and Hamilton journey to breath-taking locations around the world including Venice, Istanbul, Barcelona, Jerusalem and the Pyrenees, in their quest to authenticate the rare and precious antiquities from Hamilton's collection.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: Legends of lost and mysterious islands, advanced civilizations and Eden-like paradises have been told by sailors throughout human history. Is it possible these stories are more than just the myths of imaginative seafarers? Might evidence of our Ancient Alien origins be found by exploring the world's most remote islands--strategic spots where extraterrestrials may have once made their earthly homes... and possibly still visit today? Unidentified submersible objects going at lightning speed... strange crafts coming out of water near remote volcanic islands... and mystifying megalithic ruins in the middle of the ocean. Is it possible UFO activity could be hidden deep underwater and off the coasts of islands? Could this explain why so many islands around the world have stories of unexplained sightings of objects both overhead and beneath the sea going back centuries?

programme.title: Unidentified: Inside America's UFO Investigation
programme.desc: In an international UFO hotspot, Lue Elizondo uncovers exclusive video of a glowing orb recorded recently by an airline pilot at 35,000 feet and investigates possible connections to secret technology related to the USSR, plus a shocking aerial battle between a jet fighter pilot and an UFO. Local people reveal an ancient connection, as high-ranking officials drop a Project Blue Book bombshell. The planetary threat of UFOS is explored.

programme.title: UFO Hunters
programme.desc: The team's access to UFO evidence is unparalleled and their expertise allows them to quickly identify bogus claims of UFOs. Together, they use eyewitness accounts, scientific experimentation, documents recently released through the Freedom of Information Act and footage that has never been seen before on television to piece together compelling — and at times chilling — evidence of UFO phenomena. Join UFO Hunters Bill Birnes, Pat Uskert, Dr. Ted Acworth, and Jeff Tomlinson as they separate fact from fallacy.

programme.title: UFO Files
programme.desc: In the search for life beyond our planet, this documentary investigates areas on earth that are said to have had UFO activity, conspiracy theories and phenomenons. Interviewing a variety of scientists and experts on UFOs and examining when possible evidence can prove or suggest anything towards super natural life. From going off of tales that have been told and spread through generations and or cultures to personal experiences where sighting have occurred the series covers the super natural phenomenon that is life beyond earth.

programme.title: Hunting Hitler
programme.desc: An FBI cold case that has laid dormant for 70 years leads a group of world-renown investigators on the ultimate manhunt to finally answer the question: Did Adolf Hitler survive World War II? In early 2014 the FBI declassified hundreds of confidential documents showing that Hitler may have not committed suicide but rather escaped to South America after the fall of Germany. A memo from J. Edgar Hoover himself states "American Army officials in Germany have not located Hitler's body nor is there any reliable source that will say definitely that Hitler is dead." Armed with the most cutting edge technology and these newly released FBI files the team will approach this case like a modern death claims investigation. Whether they are investigating a mysterious Nazi lair deep in the Argentinian jungle or diving for evidence of a missing U-Boat that could of shuttled Hitler to South America our team will focus on the tried and tested tenants for solving a fraudulent death case: follow the money where was the subject last seen, eyewitness reports, make contact with known associates and forensics.With declassified worldwide intelligence providing a wealth of new clues and modern technology never before available we reopen this world famous cold case in hopes of solving the mystery surrounding the demise of one of the biggest criminals of all time.

programme.title: Ancient Aliens
programme.desc: The Ark of the Covenant is one of the most sought after religious relics of all times and far more than just a box that contained the Ten Commandments. The biblical stories surrounding the Ark speak of a device with divine powers that was able to produce food, take down stonewalls, kill those that come in contact with it, and provide direct communication to God. Are these stories mere myth? Or did the Ark of the Covenant possess extraordinary powers? What happened to this incredible relic? Could it still be hidden? Are we getting close to a rediscovery--and reactivation--of the Ark? And if so, will the Ark of the Covenant reveal a long, lost connection to our extraterrestrial past?

programme.title: Lost Worlds
programme.desc: Documentary series that brings back to life lost cities, structures, cultures, and civilisations, transporting viewers back in time and revealing the truth behind some of history's most iconic eras. Using a combination of cutting-edge technology and archaeological research, the team detail what life was like for these places during their peak of their powers, and use visual overlays to compare past and present landscapes. From the Knights Templar to the lost city of Atlantis, ancient Egypt to Hitler's planned supercity, and ancient Athens to America's wild west, each episodes dives into these extraordinary remnants of human history.

programme.title: Bible Secrets Revealed
programme.desc: Documentary series in which viewers have a chance to explore the mysteries and reveal secrets and hidden facts of the world's most famous and oldest book - the Bible. For thousands of years, The Holy Bible has been the foundation on which Judaism and Christianity are built, but there are still many secrets and things which can be interpreted differently. Featuring stunning on-location photography, interesting reenactments and interviews with scientists, archaeologists and religious leaders, this series will take us on remarkable journey back in time to see what the Old Testament and the New Testament are hiding from us - from Dead Sea Scrolls, examinations of the traditional belief that Moses wrote the Torah, to whether Adam and Eve were created together or one before the other, who authored the New Testament and many other mysteries.

programme.title: Digging for the Truth
programme.desc: Digging for the Truth was a History Channel television series. The first three seasons of the show focused on host Josh Bernstein, who journeyed on various explorations of historical icons and mysteries. Bernstein is the president and CEO of BOSS and has a degree in anthropology and psychology from Cornell University. The show airs every Monday night at 9:00 EST on the History Channel. The series premiered in January, 2005 and has since become the highest-rated series in the history of The History Channel, which was surprising given the previous show "Time Titans" from the production crew never made it past the pilot. The third season premiered on January 22, 2007, with a 2-hour special event on the quest for Atlantis. Bernstein announced on February 20, 2007, that he would be leaving The History Channel and Digging for the Truth, and would, as of April, join The Discovery Channel as an executive producer and host of a new prime-time series and specials. Hunter Ellis, host of Tactical to Practical and Man, Moment, Machine for The History Channel, then replaced Josh Bernstein as host.

With dramatic reconstructions that paint a picture of the brutal killing, each episode focusses on a respective case, as detectives scramble to catch the killer. Every potential item of evidence is pieced together, hoping to complete the sinister puzzle and bring justice for the family and friends of the deceased. As they uncover more about the victims, the detectives learn of their dark and mysterious secrets.

programme.title: Swamp Murders
programme.desc: Explore the true stories behind some of the most gruesome murder scenes discovered in America's vast deserted swamplands. Follow in the footsteps of the leading detectives on each case as they get to work retracing the steps of the suspects and their victims. With dramatic recreations and exclusive interviews, each episode delves deep into the murky waters that cloud their investigations in the hopes of discovering what really happened and finally delivering justice to the victims and their families.

programme.desc: A couple goes missing from their rural Kentucky home, leaving behind a mysterious crime scene. Clues emerge across state lines and an unlikely source reveals the shocking truth.

programme.title: The Murder Tapes
programme.desc: Crime documentary series that examines homicide investigations using unfiltered footage, including body-cam, surveillance and interrogation-room footage, giving viewers a chance to follow a case from beginning to end. The series will give viewers a chance to experience how homicide cases are conducted, from the initial crime scene investigations by body cam, to home security tapes, to interrogation room footage of real confessions. Real tapes of the investigations will be combined with interviews with friends, family members, and law enforcement directly involved in the case.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates: Surviving A Serial Killer
programme.desc: A scorned, abusive lover hunts the Dallas suburbs for his ex. When he can't find her, he unleashes his revenge on residents.

programme.title: 911: Did the Killer Call?
programme.desc: A woman vanishes, and her husband calls 911. Months later, police find her badly beaten body and make him the prime suspect.

programme.title: The Idaho College Murders: Catching Kohberger
programme.desc: New evidence reveals the disturbing profile of killer Bryan Kohberger, from body cam footage to digital forensics, exposing who he really was.

programme.title: Signs Of A Psychopath
programme.desc: For every sadistic psychopath...there were signs. Charm. Narcissism. Lack of empathy. Impulsiveness. Manipulation. Deception. These traits and others are the telltale Signs of a Psychopath. This harrowing half-hour archive series revisits some of the most brutal killers in modern history, reviewing news footage and the words of the killers themselves to see which terrifying traits each killer exhibited. What are the signs...of evil?

programme.title: Reasonable Doubt
programme.desc: As we all know, the initial verdict in a trial is not always the final outcome as many trial jury decisions are often overturned on appeal. However, the appeals process can take a significant amount of time to go through the system and also incur enormous costs on the individuals involved. This show follows the work of two investigators who re-examine the verdicts in contentious murder cases and assess the prospects of a successful appeal for the families of the people convicted of the crimes to determine if they should appeal or accept the verdict. Each episode traces the developments in the case, whether it be new evidence or witness testimony, which can then shed light on the innocence of the convicted person or show that, indeed, they are guilty of the crime and the verdict was correct.

programme.title: Прямой эфир
programme.desc: Блогер-миллионник Егор в погоне за контентом отправляется на съемки тест-драйва автомобиля в Кавказские горы. Все выходит из-под контроля в тот момент, когда сотрудник автокомпании Александр, помогающий Егору, случайно наступает на боевую мину, а Егор решает на этом хайпануть. Теперь, когда один борется за собственную жизнь, а второй за миллионные просмотры — каждый сам за себя. Но им вместе придется принять одно общее решение.

programme.title: Оперативная память
programme.desc: Документальный сериал о том, как обществом и властью по-разному трактуются и используются в угоду текущей политической целесообразности события недавнего прошлого. На современном постсоветском пространстве – в странах бывшего СССР и Восточного блока – по-разному вспоминают и оценивают события, которые происходили на протяжении последнего столетия. Существует огромное количество крайне болезненных эпизодов недавней истории. Не доверяя профессионалам и провластным СМИ, граждане все чаще сами берутся за сбор информации. Вокруг мест, связанных со спорными историческими событиями, возникают спонтанные мемориалы, объединения краеведов, основываются частные архивы и музеи. Задача авторов сериала – не "установить окончательную истину" по спорным фрагментам истории, а предоставить разнообразие актуальных мнений.

programme.title: Оперативная память
programme.desc: Один из самых жёстких политических режимов Европы был уничтожен народным восстанием буквально в течение нескольких суток. Но что происходит со страной, которая внезапно обрела свободу? Как построить демократию в государстве, где десятилетиями уничтожалась любое свободомыслие? Одним из действенных инструментов построения новых политических институтов является люстрация. И опыт ее применения в Румынии - один из самых противоречивых и наглядных примеров того, с какими проблемами сталкивается общество, на пути к демократии.

programme.title: Диссиденты и безумие
programme.desc: Можно ли вылечить от инакомыслия? Сколько длится такое лечение, и как понять, что человек болен? Авторы диагноза "вялотекущая шизофрения" академики Снежневский и Лунц изобрели инструмент, с помощью которого сумасшедшим можно было признать любого неугодного власти человека. На примере украинского диссидента Леонида Плюща свидетели и борцы с карательной психиатрией в Советском Союзе рассказывают о психиатрических репрессиях.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: В воде не тонет, в огне не горит! НАСА тестирует в бассейне свой новый лунный скафандр. Кротовая нора! Нобелевская премия по физике досталась исследователям черных дыр - узнаем, что это значит для современной науки Невидимые нити! Расскажем о новых, способных проводить электричество, волокнах.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Полет шмеля! Расскажем, зачем ученые прикрепляют к насекомым сенсоры и камеры. Жизнь собачья! Посмотрим, как на заводе Ford работает знаменитый робот-пес компании Boston Dynamic. На страже! Спутник Sentinel-6 готовится к грядущему запуску - он будет следить за глобальным потеплением на планете Земля.

programme.title: Детали
programme.desc: Армагедон! Аппарат НАСА высадился на астероиде и взял на нем образцы пород. Скрытый потенциал! Ученые из университета Вашингтона "научили" обычный кирпич накапливать электричество. Атлантида! Исследователи предупреждают о скором бесследном исчезновении Большого Барьерного рифа.

programme.title: Северное сияние. Ведьмины куклы
programme.desc: Известная писательница Агата Север и ее помощница Маруся возвращаются на остров, чтобы разгадать семейный секрет. Поездка превращается в настоящий кошмар. Тетя Агаты погибает при загадочных обстоятельствах, а вскоре писательница становится подозреваемой в убийстве своей двоюродной сестры. Чтобы снять с себя обвинение, Агате предстоит пролить свет на тайны прошлого и раскрыть преступление, случившееся на острове много лет назад.
